decision.reason: Cross-table identifier coherence leaves only one matched extinction event/risk set under every frozen threshold; the contract requires at least five informative risk sets.

ecological_interpretation: The available chick snapshot cannot support a colony-level test of reproductive performance immediately before durable colony-code extinction. This is an identification/coverage limit, not evidence that reproductive performance is unrelated to extinction.
paper_implication: Do not use colony-level chick production as corroboration of the extinction mechanism. Move the reproductive test to island-level aggregation, where code splitting and relabeling do not determine the unit of inference.
